abilities.name: Heavenly Restriction
abilities.description: A complete lack of cursed energy exchanged for extraordinary physical ability.

abilities.name: Enhanced Senses
abilities.description: Toji's five senses are sharpened enough to detect curses and track sorcerers without cursed energy.

abilities.name: Superhuman Physical Ability
abilities.description: Provides immense strength, speed, reflexes, durability, and agility.

abilities.name: Master Weapons Specialist
abilities.description: Toji can use a large variety of conventional and cursed weapons with exceptional skill.

abilities.name: Inventory Curse
abilities.description: A cursed spirit that stores Toji's weapons and can hide within his body.

abilities.name: Inverted Spear of Heaven
abilities.description: A special grade cursed tool that nullifies cursed techniques on contact.

abilities.name: Split Soul Katana
abilities.description: A cursed tool that bypasses physical toughness and cuts directly at the soul.

abilities.name: Chain of a Thousand Miles
abilities.description: A chain that can extend indefinitely while its far end remains hidden.
